gist.summary: Added Keigo Formatter to the writing app catalog and README. The single-page static app turns rough Japanese memos into polite business Japanese using the Pollinations text API at POST /v1/chat/completions, defaulting to deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash. It runs on GitHub Pages without a build step and supports BYOP.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art writing nook, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and helps turn a rough Japanese memo into a neatly written business letter beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
